source.description: Approved handmade raster marker-process contact sheet after a targeted early-shadow repair.
source.notes: V1 front-loaded the handle; v2 fixed staging but used navy early shadow guides. Both remain private. Approved v3 has one face-free oval hand mirror with three sparkles; no reflected face, lettering, arrows, UI, signatures, or watermarks.

process_strategy: Six cumulative panels move from an oval-and-handle scaffold to frame silhouette, handle and glass, sparkles/highlights, complete marker color map, then a finishing-only pass.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using two pale ovals, one center axis, one handle route, three sparkle ticks, and a shadow route.

anchor_map.early_mark: Two nested pale ovals on one center axis
anchor_map.becomes: The thick oval mirror frame and inner glass
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The inner oval remains evenly inset and centered inside the outer frame.
anchor_map.construction_note: Allowed pale closed primitives; no black outline or decoration in Panel 1.

anchor_map.early_mark: One downward handle route from the lower oval
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The handle stays centered on the mirror axis and attaches behind the frame at six o'clock.

anchor_map.early_mark: Three tiny ticks around the upper-right frame
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: All three remain outside the glass at their first mapped positions.

final_elements.name: mirror construction guides
final_elements.description: Two nested ovals, center axis, handle route, three sparkle ticks, and four ground-placement dashes that hold the layout into the frame stage.

final_elements.name: oval mirror frame
final_elements.description: One thick, slightly imperfect oval frame.

final_elements.name: handle and inner glass
final_elements.description: One centered rounded handle and one pale aqua inner glass oval.

final_elements.name: grip three sparkles and two highlights
final_elements.description: One inset grip shape, exactly three yellow sparkles outside the upper-right frame, and two open-paper shine marks inside the glass.

final_elements.name: marker palette and shadow
final_elements.description: Thick black outlines, purple frame and handle, pink grip accent, pale aqua glass, yellow sparkles, and one broken navy shadow.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The handle route ends behind the lower frame and the shadow route stays outside the complete mirror silhouette.

frames.visible_job: Place two nested pale ovals, one center axis, one downward handle route, three upper-right placement ticks, and four short ground-placement dashes.
Connect only the thick oval frame over the two established oval guides.
Wrap the route with one rounded handle and clarify the inner glass oval inside the established frame.
must_not_show: highlights black marker color or shadow fill

frames.visible_job: Add the inset grip outline, turn the three ticks into exactly three sparkles, and reserve exactly two open-paper shine marks inside the glass.
introduces: grip three sparkles and two highlights
establishes: grip three sparkles and two highlights
must_not_show: new face reflection lettering or props

frames.visible_job: Ink established contours and map purple, pink, pale aqua, yellow, and navy marker strokes in every planned region.
must_not_show: new mirror parts sparkles highlights face lettering or props
requires_prior_elements: grip three sparkles and two highlights

new_occlusions: The frame overlaps the top attachment of the handle.

must_persist: grip three sparkles and two highlights
grip three sparkles and two highlights

final_step.visible_job: Only complete established marker fills, strengthen selected keeper contours, and clarify the same highlights, sparkles, and shadow.

rejection_checks: Reject a first panel with black outlines, a closed handle, sparkle shapes, highlights, or color.
Reject shifting handle attachment, changing oval proportions, missing or extra sparkles/highlights, vector-like fills, or a reflected face.
Reject any final feature or color region absent from Panel 5.
